0022600229.text: The Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 10th in the West, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back) take a two-game winning streak on the road against the Minnesota Timberwolves (8-3, 4th in the West, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back), who have won four straight and gone 7-3 over their last ten. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (out, leg), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost all four meetings, most recently a 124-94 loss in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
